# Factions
## The Three Superpowers - [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"]: a coalition of the Americas. - [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"]: the Anglo-Japanese empire and the first power to settle beyond Sol. - [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"]: the authoritarian socialist rival of the UA and TWE.
## Other Nations - [textlink="Central Confederation of Africa" link="CMUGuideLoreCCA"]: a powerful African coalition with large colonial holdings. - [textlink="Independent Core System Colonies" link="CMUGuideLoreICSC"]: self-governing, largely corporate-run worlds that broke away from the Three World Empire.
## Corporations and Movements - [textlink="Weyland-Yutani" link="CMUGuideLoreWY"]: "the Company", the dominant megacorporation in human space. - [textlink="Colonial Liberation Front" link="CMUGuideLoreCLF"]: decentralized colonial insurgencies fighting for independence. - [textlink="Private Military Companies" link="CMUGuideLorePMC"]: soldiers for hire.
